subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Writing a Winning Application Letter and Resume

lesson.title: The Final Polish: Crafting Your Career Documents
lesson.content:
Welcome to your final year of English! This year is all about the 'Real World'. We start by perfecting your **Job Application Letter** and **Resume (CV)**. In Grade 12, your documents must be error-free and highly persuasive. You will learn how to use 'Action Verbs' (e.g., 'Implemented', 'Developed', 'Optimized') to describe your vocational skills.

For SMK students, your PKL experience is your biggest asset. We will practice how to describe your technical responsibilities in English so that international recruiters can see your value. Your resume should be clean, modern, and focused on results. English is the tool that will help you stand out among thousands of applicants. Let's make your first professional impression a lasting one!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Advanced Interview Techniques and STAR Method

lesson.title: Interview Mastery: Answering Like a Pro
lesson.content:
A good resume gets you an interview, but a great interview gets you the job. We will master the **STAR Method** (Situation, Task, Action, Result) to answer behavioral questions like 'Tell me about a time you solved a difficult problem'. This method ensures your answers are structured and evidence-based.

You will also learn how to handle difficult questions and how to negotiate your first salary or benefit package in English. We focus on your tone of voice and body language—confidence is key. By the end of this module, you will be able to face any international recruiter with poise and professional charm. Let's practice until you are interview-ready!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Analyzing Pros and Cons of Industrial Issues

lesson.title: Two Sides of a Coin: Mastering Discussion Texts
lesson.content:
**Discussion Text** presents a problematic discourse from different points of view. You will learn the structure: Issue, Arguments For (Pro), Arguments Against (Con), and Recommendation/Conclusion. For SMK students, this is vital for evaluating new technologies or workplace policies.

For example, we will discuss 'The Use of Robots in Manufacturing: Efficiency vs. Employment'. You learn to use contrastive conjunctions like 'However', 'On the other hand', and 'Nevertheless'. This skill trains you to be a critical thinker who can see the big picture. In a global company, being able to discuss complex issues objectively is a sign of leadership and maturity.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Reading and Writing Industrial News

lesson.title: Stay Informed: Reading Global Industry News
lesson.content:
**News Item** text informs readers about events of the day which are considered newsworthy. We focus on 'Industrial News'—new inventions, economic shifts, or mergers of big companies. You will learn the structure: Newsworthy Event, Background Events, and Sources.

Being 'well-informed' in English makes you a more valuable professional. You will practice summarizing news from sites like Bloomberg, TechCrunch, or industry-specific portals. Learning to extract the '5W+1H' from an English news article ensures you are always updated with the latest trends in your field. Information is power; let's make sure you can access it globally!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Writing a Project Completion Report

lesson.title: Project Done: Writing the Final Report
lesson.content:
Every project ends with a report. You will learn how to write a **Project Completion Report** in English. We study the formal sections: Executive Summary, Methodology, Results, and Recommendations. We use formal and objective language, often in the passive voice.

For SMK students, this could be the report for your 'Tugas Akhir' (Final Project). Writing it in English proves you can work at an international standard. You learn to describe technical data, explain challenges you faced, and how you overcame them. Clear documentation is the hallmark of a professional. Let's sharpen your technical writing for the global workplace!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Presenting Your Final Project to a Jury

lesson.title: The Big Pitch: Presenting Your Final Project
lesson.content:
This is the climax of your SMK journey. You will learn how to present your final project in English. We focus on 'Engagement'—how to keep your audience interested using hooks, stories, and clear visuals. We also practice 'Defense'—how to answer critical questions from a jury or a client.

You will learn phrases for 'Explaining Data', 'Handling Technical Glitches', and 'Concluding with Impact'. A great presentation in English can lead to job offers or investment for your own business. You are not just a student anymore; you are a professional showing your masterpiece to the world. Let's make your final presentation unforgettable!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: International Business Ethics and Culture

lesson.title: Global Manners: Cultural Intelligence (CQ) in Work
lesson.content:
Working in a global company means working with people from different cultures. We study **Cultural Intelligence**. You will learn about 'Low-context' vs 'High-context' cultures, different views on time (punctuality), and how to give feedback politely in different countries.

Understanding cultural nuances prevents misunderstandings and builds trust. For example, how do you disagree with a boss in the UK vs in Japan? Using English as a 'lingua franca' requires you to be sensitive and adaptable. This lesson makes you a 'Global Citizen' who can thrive in any office or workshop from New York to Tokyo. Let's broaden your horizons!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Handling Complaints and Conflict via Email

lesson.title: Professional Diplomacy: Handling Complaints
lesson.content:
Sometimes things go wrong. You will learn how to handle **Complaints** professionally via email. Whether you are the one complaining or the one replying to a complaint, your tone must be calm, respectful, and solution-oriented. Phrases like 'We sincerely apologize for...', 'We are looking into the matter', and 'To resolve this, we suggest...' are essential.

Managing conflict in English is a high-level communication skill. It shows that you have high 'Emotional Intelligence' (EQ). By the end of this lesson, you will know how to turn a negative situation into a positive one, keeping your clients happy and your professional reputation intact. Let's learn the language of professional diplomacy!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Understanding Invoices, Quotes, and Basic Budgets

lesson.title: Money Matters: Basic Financial English
lesson.content:
Every professional should understand the 'Money' side of the business. You will learn vocabulary related to **Invoices**, **Price Quotes**, and **Budgets**. Terms like 'Unit Price', 'VAT/Tax', 'Due Date', 'Total Amount', and 'Discount' are universal in business.

Even if you are in a technical major, you might need to request tools or bill a client. We practice reading and creating simple financial documents in English. This ensures you are not just a 'worker' but someone who understands the 'value' of your work. Financial literacy in English is a key step toward becoming an entrepreneur or a manager. Let's get comfortable with the language of business!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Lifelong Learning and Global Career Path

lesson.title: The Journey Continues: Final Reflection
lesson.content:
Congratulations! You have completed the SMK English curriculum. From basic greetings in Grade 10 to presenting complex projects in Grade 12, you have come a long way. The most important lesson is: **English is a journey, not a destination**. 

Keep reading, keep watching, and keep speaking. Use your English to access the best knowledge in the world. You are now ready to take on the world, whether you go to university, start a job, or build your own company. The world is much smaller when you speak its language. Go forth and make us proud! Merdeka!

Your future is limited only by your imagination. Keep dreaming in English!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Optimizing Your LinkedIn Profile for Global Reach

lesson.title: Digital Identity: Building a Professional LinkedIn
lesson.content: Your resume is on paper, but your LinkedIn is your 24/7 digital office. We will learn how to write a compelling 'Headline' and 'About' section in English. You learn how to use keywords so that recruiters can find you easily. For SMK students, showing your project photos and PKL certificates on LinkedIn is a game-changer. We also practice how to connect with professionals and how to write a polite 'Connection Request' in English. Your career doesn't start after graduation; it starts with your digital presence today!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Virtual Interview Best Practices

lesson.title: Screen Ready: Mastering Online Interviews
lesson.content: Many global companies now use Zoom or Google Meet for interviews. We will learn the technical and verbal etiquette for **Virtual Interviews**. This includes checking your background, lighting, and audio, as well as how to look into the camera to make eye contact. We focus on speaking clearly and handling potential technical delays with grace. Phrases like 'Can you hear me clearly?', 'Let me share my screen', and 'I'm sorry, my connection was lagging' are practiced. Being 'Tech-Savvy' and 'English-Fluent' at the same time is a winning combination!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Critical Thinking about Artificial Intelligence (AI)

lesson.title: AI and the Future: A Professional Discussion
lesson.content: Will AI take our jobs? We will use discussion texts to explore the impact of AI in various SMK fields—from Graphic Design to Automotive. You will practice presenting the pro-AI arguments (productivity, accuracy) and the con-AI arguments (job loss, ethics). This lesson is not just about English; it's about preparing your mind for the fast-changing world of work. By discussing AI in English, you show that you are a forward-thinking professional who is ready to collaborate with technology instead of fearing it.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Writing a Press Release for a School Project

lesson.title: Spread the Word: Writing a Business Press Release
lesson.content: Imagine your class invented something cool. You need to tell the world. We will learn how to write a **Press Release** in English. A press release is a type of news item that companies send to journalists. You learn how to write a 'Catchy Headline', a strong 'Lead Paragraph', and how to include 'Quotes' from the team. This skill is very useful for marketing, public relations, and entrepreneurship. It teaches you how to promote your achievements professionally to a global audience.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Describing Trends with Graphs and Charts

lesson.title: Data Talk: Describing Charts and Graphs
lesson.content: In a report or presentation, you often need to explain data. We will learn verbs of movement (increase, decrease, fluctuate, level off) and adverbs (sharply, steadily, slightly). You will practice describing Pie Charts, Bar Charts, and Line Graphs in English. For example, 'The production rate increased sharply in June'. This skill is essential for anyone who wants to work in management, accounting, or technical analysis. It makes your presentations look data-driven and highly professional.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Negotiation Skills: Reaching a Win-Win

lesson.title: Let's Negotiate: Reaching Agreements
lesson.content: Negotiation is not about winning; it's about reaching an agreement both sides can accept. We will learn phrases for 'Proposing' ('We could offer you...'), 'Bargaining' ('If you give us X, we can give you Y'), and 'Closing a Deal' ('That sounds fair, let's proceed'). You will practice negotiation scenarios like buying tools from a supplier or negotiating a deadline with a manager. This lesson builds your social confidence and teaches you how to protect your interests while remaining professional and polite in English.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Writing a Letter of Recommendation Request

lesson.title: Seeking Support: Asking for Recommendations
lesson.content: A good recommendation from your PKL supervisor can open many doors. We will learn how to write a polite and professional email asking for a **Letter of Recommendation**. You learn how to remind them of your specific contributions and how to provide them with the necessary details. Phrases like 'I am writing to ask if you would be willing to...', 'I greatly valued your mentorship', and 'I would be happy to provide my updated resume' are covered. This lesson teaches you how to maintain professional relationships and build a strong support network for your career.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Understanding Contract Terms and Conditions

lesson.title: Read Before You Sign: Basic Contract English
lesson.content: A contract is a legal agreement. We will learn common terms found in English-language work contracts: 'Termination', 'Confidentiality', 'Scope of Work', 'Force Majeure', and 'Liability'. We focus on understanding your rights and obligations as an employee. You don't need to be a lawyer, but you should know what you are signing. This lesson empowers you to protect yourself in the global job market and ensures that you enter any professional agreement with your eyes wide open.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Technical Writing: Writing a Troubleshooting FAQ

lesson.title: Self-Service Support: Writing a Technical FAQ
lesson.content: Great technicians help users help themselves. We will learn how to write a **Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)** guide in English for a common technical problem in your major. You learn to write short, clear questions and step-by-step answers. For example, 'Why is the machine overheating?' -> 'Check the coolant level'. This skill combines your technical knowledge with clear English communication. It shows that you care about 'User Experience' (UX), which is a highly valued mindset in modern industry and tech companies.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Researching International Companies and Salaries

lesson.title: Know Your Value: Global Market Research
lesson.content: How much does a junior technician earn in Singapore? What are the top companies for your major in Europe? We will learn how to use English-language sites like Glassdoor, PayScale, and company 'Careers' pages to research the global market. You will practice comparing benefits and job requirements. This research helps you set realistic goals and gives you a clear target for your career. By knowing the global standard, you can prepare yourself to meet it and even exceed it!

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Discussing Sustainable Industry Practices

lesson.title: Green Industry: A Professional Discussion on Sustainability
lesson.content: Sustainability is no longer an option; it's a requirement. We use discussion texts to debate 'The Cost of Going Green: Short-term Loss vs. Long-term Gain'. You will learn vocabulary related to the environment (carbon footprint, renewable energy, circular economy). This lesson prepares you to contribute to 'Green Initiatives' in your future company. By discussing sustainability in English, you show that you are an ethical and responsible professional who cares about the planet as much as the profit.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Body Language and Non-Verbal Communication

lesson.title: Beyond Words: Mastering Non-Verbal English
lesson.content: In an interview, 70% of communication is non-verbal. We will study the 'Language of the Body'. You learn about the power of a firm handshake (in Western culture), the importance of an upright posture, and how to use hand gestures to emphasize points without being distracting. We also discuss 'Cultural Differences in Non-Verbal Cues' (e.g., eye contact in different cultures). Mastering your body language ensures that your 'Vibe' matches your 'Words', making you appear consistent, trustworthy, and ready for leadership.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Writing a Formal Resignation Letter

lesson.title: Leaving with Grace: The Resignation Letter
lesson.content: How you leave a job is as important as how you start it. We will learn how to write a professional **Resignation Letter** in English. You learn to keep it positive, thank the employer for the opportunities, and offer help during the transition. Phrases like 'I am writing to formally resign from...', 'I have accepted a new challenge', and 'I wish the company continued success' are covered. Leaving on good terms ensures you keep your bridges open and your reputation high in the small world of professional industry.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Creating an Effective One-Pager Pitch

lesson.title: The One-Pager: Pitching Your Business Idea
lesson.content: In the startup world, you often need to pitch your idea on just one page. We will learn how to condense your big idea into a **One-Pager** in English. You learn to include: The Problem, The Solution, The Market, and The Team. This skill is vital for budding entrepreneurs. It teaches you how to be extremely concise and clear with your value proposition. Being able to explain your business idea in one page of perfect English is a sign of a sharp and highly focused mind.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Understanding Basic Supply Chain Logistics

lesson.title: Moving Goods: Logistics and Shipping English
lesson.content: If you work in production or sales, you need to understand how goods move. We will learn the English of **Logistics**: 'Shipping', 'Freight Forwarding', 'Incoterms' (EXW, FOB, CIF), and 'Lead Time'. You will practice tracking a shipment and communicating with a logistics provider about a delay. This knowledge makes you a more effective professional who understands the 'Physical' flow of the global economy. It's the language that connects your workshop to a customer on the other side of the world.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Writing a Professional Bio for Portfolios

lesson.title: This is Me: Writing Your Professional Bio
lesson.content: Your 'Bio' is a short, third-person paragraph about you (e.g., 'Budi is a passionate Web Developer with...'). We will learn how to write a bio for your website, portfolio, or a conference program. You learn how to balance your technical skills with your personal mission. A well-written bio in English tells the world who you are and why they should work with you. It's the final piece of your professional portfolio that makes you look like a seasoned expert even at the start of your career.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Fact-Checking Industry Trends in English

lesson.title: Truth Seeker: Fact-Checking for Professionals
lesson.content: Not everything you read in English is true. We will learn how to use English-language fact-checking tools and how to cross-reference news with official sources like the WHO, ISO, or major tech companies. You practice identifying 'Clickbait' and 'Fake News' in your industry. This skill protects you from making expensive mistakes based on false information. In the professional world, being someone who values 'Truth' and 'Data' above all else will earn you the respect of your peers and leaders.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Using Storytelling to Make Data Memorable

lesson.title: The Power of Story: Storytelling for Technical Talks
lesson.content: Data is cold, but stories are warm. We will learn how to use simple **Storytelling** techniques to make your technical presentations more memorable. You learn how to frame a technical problem as a 'Challenge' and your solution as the 'Hero'. This makes your audience feel more connected to your work. Even a talk about 'Engine Efficiency' can be a story. By mastering storytelling in English, you become a more influential communicator who can inspire others and lead people toward your vision for the future.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Handling Success and Promotion with Grace

lesson.title: The Upward Path: English for Career Growth
lesson.content: When you get promoted or win an award, how do you handle it in English? We will learn how to accept praise with humility and how to thank your team. Phrases like 'I am honored by...', 'This wouldn't be possible without...', and 'I'm excited for the next chapter' are covered. We also discuss how to 'Sell your success' to your boss during an annual review without sounding arrogant. This lesson prepares you for the 'Soft Side' of career success, ensuring you remain a likable and respected leader as you climb the professional ladder.

subject: Bahasa Inggris
subtopic: Final Career Roadmap and Graduation Toast

lesson.title: Graduation Ready: Your Global Career Roadmap
lesson.content: In our final lesson, you will create a '5-Year Career Roadmap' in English. Where do you want to be? What skills will you learn? We celebrate your journey by practicing a 'Graduation Toast'—a short speech to thank your teachers and friends. You have survived and thrived. You are now a global-ready professional from SMK. Take your English, take your skills, and go change the world for the better. The horizon is wide, and your future is bright. Cheers to your success! Merdeka!
